static.solution:
(a) If x is constant, we get z = 2 x^2 + a, for some value of a, so that the cross-sections are upward-opening parabolas.
(b) If y is constant, we get z = -4 y^2 + a, for some value of a, so that the cross-sections are downward-opening parabolas.
(c) If z is constant and equal to 2, we get y = \pm \sqrt{2} x, which are two intersecting straight lines.
